title: Rav Sama son of Rava

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.42b.14) before Rav Ashi in the cited passage. In [Chullin 47b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.47b.7) he said: “A lung that looks like a kushta or like saffron is terefah.” He is likewise mentioned in [Zevachim 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.16a.9).

Hyman cites the [Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon](https://www.sefaria.org/Epistle_of_Rav_Sherira_Gaon.1.109-110), part 3, chapter 4 in his edition, for Sama’s tenure as head of the academy in Pumbedita from 757 until 787.[^1]

notes.text: Bava Metzia places Sama’s statement immediately before Rav Ashi’s. Chullin adds an egg-like color to the comparison. The consulted Epistle puts Sama after Richumai, whose death it dates to 760, and dates Sama’s death to 787. Hyman gives 757 as the start of his tenure.
